dish.title: Garlic Tomato Mussels with Grilled Bread
dish.description: Mussels steamed in a garlic and crushed-tomato broth, finished with parsley and lemon, with oil-brushed bread toasted in a skillet.

provenance.process: FlavorWeave Catalog Factory Dry Run #1, Grok Bot only

recipe_version.immutability_note: v1 has not been planned, shopped, cooked, or rated. Any material change after that history needs v2. This dry run does not rewrite a prior version.
recipe_version.title: Garlic Tomato Mussels with Grilled Bread
recipe_version.description: Mussels steamed in a garlic and crushed-tomato broth, finished with parsley and lemon, with oil-brushed bread toasted in a skillet.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.note: divided: 2 tbsp in the pot, 1 tbsp on the bread

ingredients.name: crusty bread
ingredients.note: one baguette or small ciabatta, 8 slices

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.note: half juiced into the pot, half cut into wedges

steps.title: Clean the mussels
steps.body: Rinse the mussels under cold water and scrub the shells. Pull off any beards. Discard cracked shells, any mussel that smells off, and any mussel that stays open after a firm tap. Do not add a long salt soak; it is not part of this timing.

steps.title: Prep the bread and aromatics
steps.body: Slice the crusty bread into 8 pieces and brush the slices with 1 tbsp of the olive oil. Dice the onion, slice the garlic, and chop the fresh parsley.

steps.title: Start the broth
steps.body: Warm the remaining 2 tbsp olive oil in a wide 8-quart pot over medium heat. Cook the onion for 3 minutes, until softened. Add the garlic and red pepper flakes and cook 1 minute. Do not let the garlic brown.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.body: Add the crushed tomatoes, dry white wine, kosher salt, and black pepper. Simmer 4 minutes so the wine cooks off its raw edge and the tomatoes thicken slightly.

steps.title: Steam the mussels
steps.body: Raise the heat to medium-high. Add the mussels, cover the pot, and cook 4 to 6 minutes, until the shells open. Shake the pot once halfway. Discard any mussel that is still closed. Do not cook them longer or they turn rubbery.

steps.title: Toast the bread
steps.body: While the mussels steam, toast the oiled crusty bread in a skillet or grill pan over medium-high, about 1 to 2 minutes per side, until the edges char. This is a skillet char, not a separate grilled meal.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: Take the pot off the heat. Squeeze in the juice of half the lemon and toss in the fresh parsley. Serve the mussels in their broth with the remaining lemon as wedges and the toasted bread. There is no pasta and no cheese.

components.name: tomato garlic broth
components.note: Built in the pot from the listed aromatics, canned crushed tomatoes, and dry white wine. Those two store-bought inputs are labeled on the ingredients. There is no separate bottled sauce.

recipe_version.heat: Medium for the onion and garlic, then a 4-minute simmer, then medium-high under a lid for the mussels. Bread toasts over medium-high.
recipe_version.doneness: Mussels are done when the shells open, usually 4 to 6 minutes. Discard any that stay closed. Do not cook them until they shrink.

curator_preflight.detail: Every listed ingredient name appears in a step. No finish item is introduced only in the method.
The cooking fat is a named ingredient with a quantity and is used in the method: olive oil.

The broth is built in the pot from listed ingredients. Crushed tomatoes are canned and labeled. Dry white wine is a plain ingredient, not a mystery cooking liquid. Bread is toasted, not a separate recipe. No pesto, crema, or bottled mussel sauce.
prep 15 + cook 13 = total 28. Step durations are written to match that sum without hiding a required wait.
Base is 4 servings. Quantities scale by 0.25 / 0.5 / 1. See scaling_notes for cloves, eggs, wine, and time that must not be scaled blindly.

dietary_labels stay dairy_free: no butter, cream, or cheese. Structured allergens are shellfish and wheat, matching mussels and the required crusty bread. Wheat is outside the live enum and is still on the array. This revision is not a Vale pass.
vocabulary_tag_ids are existing D-02 slugs only. No invented beef/mussels/pork tag.

scaling_notes.1: 1 lb mussels and 2 slices of bread. Do not scale the liquid to a splash or the pot scorches: keep at least 1 tsp olive oil, 1 garlic clove, 2 tbsp diced onion, 1/4 cup crushed tomatoes, and 1/4 cup dry white wine. Steam time stays about 4 to 6 minutes. Still discard closed shells.
scaling_notes.2: 2 lb mussels. Halve the aromatics, tomatoes, parsley, and bread. Keep at least 1/3 cup wine. Same heat and the same open-shell test.
scaling_notes.4: As written. 1 lb mussels per person is a main, not an appetizer portion. Use a wide 8-quart pot so they cook in one batch.

coverage_contribution: Fills a second shellfish meal that is not shrimp pasta, a one-pot steam, a sub-30 non-bowl, and a briny tomato finish the catalog does not have.
near_duplicate_review: Shares garlic, lemon, parsley, and olive oil with Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta. Those are pantry overlaps. The meal is a different animal, no pasta, a tomato-wine steam, and skillet bread. It is not a second shrimp sauté.
